scope: ordered schema replay and read-only tenant inventory on an isolated populated archive copy

restore.restore_method: age streamed directly into pg_restore on a fresh template0 database; no plaintext dump file

preflight_runner.encrypted_secrets_file: masked in the one-shot container; synthetic database credentials only

migration_replay.transaction_policy: each migration body and ledger row applied in one transaction

array_decode_correction.finding: The PostgreSQL driver returned an empty uuid[] value as the string '{}'; iterating it produced two false opaque organization references.
array_decode_correction.correction: Aggregate organization IDs as text[] and reject any non-list/tuple array representation before classifying ownership.
array_decode_correction.corrected_read_only_preflight: passed; no relationship candidates were reported

cleanup.incomplete_first_boot_container_and_netw: removed; its separate empty recovery volume retained without archive restore or migrations

rollback: The migrations were applied only to a detached recovery copy. Preserve the encrypted source archive and retained recovery volume for review; no active deployment rollback is needed. Discarding this isolated volume returns to the unchanged source archive.
limitations: The archived data snapshot does not establish accountable ownership: one direct assignment lacks a matching active owned-primary relationship, and one location is unassigned.
Three report snapshots and 38 dashboard datasets have no location; these database-wide totals require separate lineage review.
The known-relation inventory is not complete export, backup, or downstream lineage proof and does not verify or enable RLS.
No ownership reconciliation, backfill, tenant grant, RLS migration, or test suite was performed.
